list.title: Departures
list.intro: Group batches with seats: who has booked, who is holding, and who is waiting.
list.empty: No departures yet. Add the first batch to start taking seats.

form.description: A batch with a number of seats. Seats sold and held are worked out from the bookings and holds.
form.title: Name
form.priceHint: Leave it empty when each quote sets its own price.
form.cutoffHint: Leave it empty for no cut-off.

page.title: Departure
page.notFound: This departure isn't here any more.
page.cancelledBookings: {count, plural, one {# booking is still on it} other {# bookings are still on it}}. Move or cancel each.
page.overbooked: Overbooked by {count}: more people are booked than there are seats.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this departure?
cancelDialog.description: Its holds are released and its waitlist cleared. Bookings on it stay: move or cancel each of them.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.none: No bookings on this departure yet.

holds.title: Held seats
holds.releaseDescription: They go back to the free seats at once, and the first person waiting is told.

holdDialog.title: Hold seats
holdDialog.description: Keep seats for a lead until a time. They count as held until they expire, are released or become a booking.
holdDialog.hoursHint: Empty means the agency's usual {hours} hours.

waitlist.title: Waitlist
waitlist.addDescription: When seats free up, the first lead whose party fits has its owner told.

rooming.title: Rooming list
rooming.intro: Where each traveller sleeps at each hotel. Names and requests only.
rooming.none: No hotels yet. Add the first stay to plan the rooms.
rooming.removeStayDescription: Its rooms and who is in them go. Travellers stay on the departure.
rooming.draftedLeft: {count, plural, one {# traveller has no room yet} other {# travellers have no room yet}}
rooming.copied: {count, plural, =0 {Every other stay already has rooms} one {Copied to # stay} other {Copied to # stays}}

pdfStates.none: Not sent to the hotel yet
pdfStates.out_of_date: Out of date: the rooms changed after it was made

rooming.removeRoomDescription: Whoever is in it goes back under Unassigned.

requests.near_group: Wants to be near the group

stayForm.description: A hotel the batch sleeps in, with its days.
stayForm.supplierHint: Optional: the hotel from your suppliers.

roomForm.label: Room
roomForm.labelHint: Its number or name, such as 101.

costs.title: Costs and profit
costs.intro: The bookings' price before GST, against what they cost and what the departure itself costs.
costs.none: No cost of the whole departure yet: the hotel block, the bus.
costs.voidDescription: It stays on record, marked as removed, and no longer counts.

quote.title: Departure
quote.onDescription: The quote's dates are the departure's. When the traveller accepts, the booking takes the seats.
quote.dialogTitle: Add this quote to a departure
quote.dialogDescription: Its first day becomes the departure's.
quote.none: There is no open departure to add it to.

lead.title: Seats held and waiting
lead.hold: {count, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}} held on {title}, {day}, until {time}
lead.waitlist: Waiting for {count, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}} on {title}, {day}

settings.title: Departures
settings.intro: How long seats are held, when a batch reads "Filling fast", and how many beds a room has when the rooms are drafted.
settings.holdHoursHint: Staff can hold for less on any one hold.
settings.fillingFastPercent: Filling fast at (percent of seats free)
settings.fillingFastHint: A batch with this share of its seats free, or fewer, reads Filling fast.
